title: Two redox-responsive LysR-type transcription factors control the oxidative stress response of Agrobacterium tumefaciens.
authors: Schmidt, Janka J; Brandenburg, Vivian B; Elders, Hannah; Shahzad, Saba; Schakermann, Sina; Fiedler, Ronja; Knoke, Lisa R; Pfander, Yvonne; Dietze, Pascal; Bille, Hannah; Gartner, Bela; Albin, Lennart J; Leichert, Lars I; Bandow, Julia E; Hofmann, Eckhard; Narberhaus, Franz
one_liner_zh: 该文研究农杆菌中两个LysR型转录因子OxyR和LsrB的氧化应激调控功能，虽涉及TF-DNA调控但未聚焦结合位点预测或互作机制建模，仅用AlphaFold和cryo-EM验证结构，方法上AI/物理模拟应用较浅，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作相关但深度不足。
abstract: Pathogenic bacteria often encounter fluctuating reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels, particularly during host infection, necessitating robust redox-sensing mechanisms for survival. The LysR-type transcriptional regulator (LTTR) OxyR is a widely conserved bacterial thiol-based redox sensor. However, members of the Rhizobiales also encode LsrB, a second LTTR with potential redox-sensing function. This study explores the roles of OxyR and LsrB in the plant-pathogen Agrobacterium tumefaciens. Through single and combined deletions, we observed increased H2O2 sensitivity, underscoring their function in oxidative defense. Genome-wide transcriptome profiling under H2O2 exposure revealed that OxyR and LsrB co-regulate key antioxidant genes, including katG, encoding a bifunctional catalase/peroxidase. Agrobacterium tumefaciens LsrB possesses four cysteine residues potentially involved in redox sensing. To elucidate the structural basis for redox-sensing, we applied single-particle cryo-EM (cryogenic electron microscopy) to experimentally confirm an AlphaFold model of LsrB, identifying two proximal cysteine pairs. In vitro thiol-trapping coupled with mass spectrometry confirmed reversible thiol modifications of all four residues, suggesting a functional role in redox regulation. Collectively, these findings reveal that A. tumefaciens employs two cysteine-based redox sensing transcription factors, OxyR and LsrB, to withstand oxidative stress encountered in host and soil environments.
abstract_zh: 病原细菌经常遭遇波动的活性氧（ROS）水平，尤其是在宿主感染期间，因此需要强大的氧化还原感应机制以维持生存。LysR型转录调控因子（LTTR）OxyR是一种广泛保守的细菌硫醇基氧化还原传感器。然而，根瘤菌目（Rhizobiales）的成员还编码LsrB，这是第二种具有潜在氧化还原感应功能的LTTR。本研究探讨了OxyR和LsrB在植物病原体农杆菌（Agrobacterium tumefaciens）中的作用。通过单基因和联合缺失，我们观察到H2O2敏感性增加，突显了它们在氧化防御中的功能。在H2O2暴露下的全基因组转录组分析揭示，OxyR和LsrB共同调控关键抗氧化基因，包括编码双功能过氧化氢酶/过氧化物酶的katG。农杆菌LsrB具有四个可能参与氧化还原感应的半胱氨酸残基。为了阐明氧化还原感应的结构基础，我们应用单颗粒冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）实验验证了LsrB的AlphaFold模型，识别出两对邻近的半胱氨酸。体外硫醇捕获结合质谱分析确认了所有四个残基的可逆硫醇修饰，表明其在氧化还原调控中的功能作用。综合来看，这些发现揭示农杆菌利用两种基于半胱氨酸的氧化还原感应转录因子OxyR和LsrB，以抵御宿主和土壤环境中遇到的氧化应激。
